comparisons.reason: Both are any-comment binary features over OC_comments, but the constructs differ. Feature 0 requires specific empirical evidence (statistics, data, studies, documented factual cases) and excludes hypotheticals. Feature 1 accepts any particularized illustrative example, including hypothetical scenarios or non-real-world cases, and does not require empirical evidence. Feature 1 also excludes examples quoted from the OP. Feature 0 is narrower in what counts, so the two can give different labels on the same row.
